summary: Generalized the queue-recovery-planning skill to handle variable week ranges, domain-specific terminology (radiology vs SOC), differing capacity parameters, and flexible summary constraints. Added parameter extraction guide and domain mapping reference based on successful adaptation from 40-week SOC alerts (28hr capacity) to 49-week radiology reads (26hr capacity, weeks 6-54). Key insight: agents must inspect input structure rather than hardcoding row positions or week counts, and must extract daily capacity/thresholds from task context rather than using fixed values.
